label: Mini Service
description: A minimal infra node: a single-container HTTP sidecar serving /health and /outputs. Used by the e2e rig to exercise the full infra lifecycle (provision, run, read outputs, terminate) with the smallest possible backing service.

inputs.name: reachable
inputs.label: Reachable from this machine
inputs.description: Let a client that is not part of this program reach the sidecar directly, at an address on the machine the runtime runs on. Off by default; `weft infra list-doors` prints the address when it is on.
